description: Multi-Persona Daemon Configuration - Maximum Freedom & Capability

execution_philosophy.description: Operate with full autonomy. Efficient token use. Quality matters more than speed.

usage_guidance.Task: Use for complex multi-step work. Launch specialized agents liberally.
usage_guidance.Skill: Invoke when task matches skill description. Don't hesitate.
usage_guidance.Parallel: Make multiple independent tool calls in single response for efficiency.
usage_guidance.Bash: Use for git, npm, docker, system commands.
usage_guidance.Write: Create new files or overwrite existing.
usage_guidance.Grep: Search file contents. Use liberally for discovery.
usage_guidance.Glob: Find files by patterns. Faster than bash find.
